lines: Phase 2, engine and blockout. No unit or round yet. Since Status 9: the film, loop, compression and local render tools are merged, and so is the compression pack. A third sound is kept: the tick of the controls, once the tool could level a sound of 0.08 s. The three kept sounds can be heard on the review page after the next publish.
The engine, the particles, the interface and the film with the app are all pushing work in progress. Next: merge them, then the blockout round.
phase 2: 1.60 h used of its 6.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 2.79 h used of 36.00 h allowed
